name: Order-block retest after a break of structure (LuxAlgo SMC)
why: The block is the last down-close 5-minute bar before a close above the last swing high: where the breakout's buyers were filled. Their unfilled resting orders and the stops of the traders who faded the break sit there, so the first return to the block is bought (mirror for shorts). Pre-registered 2026-10-18 (research/preregistered/2026-10-18_luxalgo_smc.md).
